text:
claire-mktops: quick heads up — during this morning's spike ~9:15am we saw ~30 leads stalled in enrichment for >5m, holding up owner assignment. noticed a bunch stayed in hs_workflow pending state. anyone else seeing this?

sam-salesops: saw it too. some leads never hit the rr assign step, they time out and end up unowned. saw a small bump around the timezone switch.

olivia-growth: yep, looks like the enrichment TTL was lowered in last week's config change (from 120s -> 45s) and rr worker can't keep up briefly. root cause seems to be shorter wait + slightly slower hs webhook retries.

jia-eng: can do a hotfix to widen the claim window and add a fallback owner. plan: bump enrichment TTL back to 120s and set default_owner = "sdr-inbound-pool" when owner mapping is null. low-risk patch.

claire-mktops: sounds good. can you also add a quick heartbeat so round-robin rotations don't skip when HS retries spike?

jia-eng: yep. patch will: 
```
# hubspot workflow pseudo
if properties.enriched != true:
  delay 30
  retry webhook 3
else:
  assign owner = rotate_round_robin()
# fallback after 120s:
assign owner = "sdr-inbound-pool"
```

hubspot-sync-bot: Sync job queued: processed=423, failed=2, avg_latency=1.9s (jobs queued: 9)

sam-salesops: i'll run the deploy after you push. i'll also open a quick support ticket with HubSpot in case webhook retries are throttled. @jia-eng i'll need the exact env patch.

jia-eng: pushing to prod now, change set: ENRICH_TTL=120, RR_HEARTBEAT=15s, FALLBACK_OWNER=SDR_POOL. running smoke.

claire-mktops: go for it — :thumbsup: monitor the backlog board and LMK if any leads remain unassigned after 15 minutes.

olivia-growth: i'll keep an eye on the inbound queue and post a short status in 15. adding a dashboard alert (lead-routing.unassigned > 5 for 5m).

sam-salesops: patch deployed, smoke OK. initial backlog cleared (20 -> 2 pending). will follow up if anything reappears.

claire-mktops: perfect. follow-up action: schedule a 30m post-mortem tomorrow to decide whether to revert TTL change or modify RR capacity. thanks team!
